purpose: Teach: 目下/下車/一向に/終結/逸脱/釈放/破棄/自爆

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、目下の業績を回復させろ
lines.en: Our company's performance needs to recover. Make it happen.
lines.style: Clipped, commanding. Crisp attack on each phrase. No softening. The authority of someone who expects results, not discussion. Brief eye contact that closes the topic.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。出張から下車した直後に報告いたします
lines.en: Understood. I'll have a full report ready as soon as I'm back from the business trip.
lines.style: Measured, respectful. A slight pause after the acknowledgment—preparing to deliver. Steady tempo, clear enunciation. The tone of someone who has already begun executing in his head.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、売上が一向に伸びない商品は撤退しろ
lines.en: Any product line that isn't growing—pull it. We're not carrying dead weight.
lines.style: Direct, unyielding. Each clause lands with weight. Slight hardening on "dead weight." No room for negotiation in the delivery, though not unkind. The voice of pragmatism.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。プロジェクト終結のロードマップを引きます
lines.en: Understood. I'm already mapping out the project closure process and timeline.
lines.style: Confident, attentive. Steady cadence. A note of quiet competence—showing he's already ahead of the ask. Not defensive, just efficient. Slightly faster than the previous response.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、規範から逸脱した社員は処分しろ
lines.en: Anyone who steps outside the line—there will be consequences.
lines.style: Cold clarity. The emphasis lands on consequences without shouting. Sparse, chilling. The pause before the final word carries the weight. A voice making something clear that shouldn't need to be said twice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。長期在庫の釈放販売を提案いたします
lines.en: Understood. I'm proposing we liquidate the long-term inventory stock immediately.
lines.style: Smooth pivot. A hint of confidence in proposing an alternative solution. Clear, unhurried pacing. The tone of someone offering something useful, not just complying. Slightly warmer than the previous lines.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 破棄寸前の契約書を整理しろ
lines.en: Get those nearly-lapsed contracts organized. File them properly.
lines.style: Brisk, tactical. Sharp focus. Each instruction is a separate action item. No elaboration. The tone of checking boxes before moving to the next thing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広告では自爆覚悟の挑戦的キャンペーンを企画しております
lines.en: Understood. We're planning an aggressive advertising campaign—bold moves that could backfire, but that's the point.
lines.style: Direct, almost conspiratorial. A slight acceleration on the clause about backfiring—owning the risk. The tone of someone willing to bet it all on a play he believes in. Lean forward slightly in delivery.
